notes.title: Patch 2.0.1 - Bug fix
notes.notes:
Changes:
 - Auto Max Players is no longer enabled by default, so games should still run even if we're unable to fetch live Twitch stats from your account. Connection errors are still being investigated, but games should still be able to run as normal.
 - Enabled support for non-alphanumerical characters. Certain names will no longer be invisible.
 - Added intro animation to EULA- popup.
